source_text.ISS-0917:
id: ISS-0917
title: "Catalog SERVICE_TASK cannot execute: ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2 is an unconditional {:error,:not_registered}; POST /tasks/:id/complete returns 500 when the next node is a catalog-only SERVICE_TASK"
discovered_by: RELEASE-VALIDATOR
discovered_in_run: WF02-REQ432-20260930 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-09-30T20:50:51Z"
severity: MAJOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by WF02-REQ432-20260930 (REQ-432 live pipeline run,
  test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml; step-02b-rework1-frontend-
  dev.json). A process whose SERVICE_TASK references a service_id (catalog_entry pin) cannot
  ever execute: Letflow.Engine.ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2
  (lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex ~411-416) returns {:error,:not_registered}
  unconditionally, so activation renders an empty URL. Measured live: completing the
  preceding human task hops synchronously into the SERVICE_TASK, the engine persists only
  EXECUTION_ERROR (affected node n3, error_type service_task_url_rendered_empty, no
  TASK_COMPLETED for the completed task) and POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete answers HTTP
  500 (probably needs a non-500 mapping for {:instance_execution_error,_,_} in
  lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex). Independent of service retirement. Consequence: scenario
  platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change EO-001/EO-004 'the in-flight step completes
  without error' cannot be met on success; REQ-432's pipeline spec accepts the measured
  outcome (B) as a documented limitation. Needed: resolve service_id through the instance's
  PINNED service_catalog version (Letflow.Engine.PinResolver / ServiceCatalog lookup) in the
  dispatcher, then tighten the REQ-432 spec step 03 to require success. SCOPE GAP already
  noted in design docs lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md and
  lib/letflow/design/req432-rebind-pins-publish-retire-ui.md (M5). Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via
  CODE-DESIGNER). Severity MAJOR.
  NOTE (added by ORCH at close-out of the cancelled duplicate run WF02-REQ432-20260930): the
  REQ-432 implementation that actually landed on main is PR #2055 (5d7ca7bf), not this run's
  branch. Its spec (web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change
  .pipeline.e2e.spec.ts, header 'Scope note (deliberately not exercised): SERVICE_TASK dispatch')
  never drives a token onto the SERVICE_TASK node, so on main the scenario's 'the in-flight step
  completes without error' (EO-001/EO-004 step 3) is unverified; the evidence of this stub's effect
  is the duplicate run's live finding (archived on remote branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930,
  handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-02b-rework1-frontend-dev.json and step-05-release-validator.json).
source_reports:
  - handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-05-release-validator.json
  - test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex
queue_ref: Q-907  # queue allocated issue_ref ISS-0907, which collides with an existing local file; local filename kept as ISS-0917 (next free on origin/main) and GH-2057 retitled to match
github_ref: GH-2057
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 2b: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR hard gate on lib/letflow/design/iss0917-catalog-service-task-pinned-dispatch.md (CODE-DESIGNER handoff: handoffs/WF03-ISS0917-20261001/step-02-code-designer.json). The 'acceptance criteria' for this issue run are: ISS-0917's description (context.source_text) as CORRECTED by the diagnosis in step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json: (a) a process whose SERVICE_TASK references a service_id (catalog_entry pin) must execute: completing the preceding human task must no longer produce EXECUTION_ERROR/HTTP 500; the URL must come from the instance's PINNED service_catalog version (not the live current row), (b) POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete must not answer 500 for this case, (c) the REQ-432 pipeline spec / scenario platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change EO-001/EO-004 must be tightened to require success, (d) fail-first regression test coverage. INDEPENDENTLY verify (do not copy the designer's claims): re-check against the actual code the file:line claims (engine.ex:906 etc.), the enumerated call sites (designer says 5 sites; diagnosis said 4: confirm the complete set of prepare_service_task_dispatch* callers), that the resolver design handles rebound pins (resolved_id nil), that the tenant visibility rule is correct against ServiceCatalog.get_for_tenant/2, that no implementation code is in the doc, that the test plan is concrete enough to write fail-first tests from and that the e2e plan is feasible (OQ-7: check how the e2e/QA env runs the dispatcher poller, SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL precedent from ISS-0930, whether the SSRF UrlValidator allows the mock host), that the D4 409 mapping and the req085 5.5.1 amendment are consistent with other docs/decision records (grep tests asserting 500 for instance_execution_error) and with docs/anti-patterns.md and docs/migration/decisions/*, and judge the 10 open questions: say which must be resolved BEFORE implementation and give a ruling for each (default or alternative). Verdict PASS / FAIL with numbered blocking issues. Complete your handoff per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md section 3. Do not edit the design file (report issues; designer reworks); only your handoff file may change. Do not commit.
acceptance_criteria: No file other than the handoff modified

result.summary:
VERDICT: FAIL (rework required; 5 blocking issues, all small and targeted - the architecture is sound and most of the design is verified correct).

INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED (against code, not the designer's claims):
- Call sites: exactly FIVE callers of prepare_service_task_dispatch exist (designer right, diagnosis' four was wrong): create via prepare_service_task_dispatch_for_create (engine.ex:563/602), completion hop via _for_completion (engine.ex:3518/3604-3638), and three through prepare_service_task_dispatch_abort_on_empty_url: timer-fire (2481), escalation-timer-fire (2702), service-task-outcome advance do_persist_service_task_advance (3106). No other consumer of {:service_task_dispatch_requested,...} exists (grep of lib/). tenant_id is already bound earlier in the `with` at the three abort-wrapper sites (2477/2698/3102); only the completion hop needs a new tenant_id_for_schema_name call (failure mapping there is unstated; MINOR).
- Design's engine.ex line numbers are stale by +13..+18 after the origin/main merge (resolve_service_task_arm_attrs is now 910-922, not 897-909; create site 563 not 550; completion 3518 not 3500). Anchoring by function name (as the design says) makes this non-blocking.
- Rebound pins: PinResolver.apply_rebind_event (pin_resolver.ex:566-596) sets resolved_id: nil / source :rebound - confirmed; the (service_id, version) resolver identity is required and the design handles it. PinLookup.catalog_lookup returns resolved_id = live version_id for START-time pins, so {:version_id, id} is the normal identity.
- Tenant visibility rule matches ServiceCatalog.get_for_tenant/2 (service_catalog.ex:491-506) exactly. Version schema has no scope/owner column (version.ex) so inheriting visibility from the live row is the only possible rule. Unique index on service_catalog_versions(service_id, version) EXISTS (migration 20260921000004:91) - OQ-8 answered.
- OQ-4 answered: PinRebind.rebind_pins locks the projection FOR UPDATE NOWAIT (pin_rebind.ex:340 lock_projection_nowait) and the completion hop holds the same row lock (M2), so a rebind cannot interleave with the hop.
- No implementation code in the doc (tables/prose/type shapes only). Error shapes specified (:not_found single atom; closed catalog_resolution_reason set; execution_error error_type union is open - execution_error.ex:99-107 - so :service_task_catalog_unresolved needs no type change).
- D4: no test or doc asserts 500 for {:instance_execution_error,_,_} at router level (grep of test/ and docs/: only engine-level assertions; tasks_test.exs line 1455 is only a 'refute 500 in statuses'). Only req085 5.5.1 (design line 555) and the router catch-all comment (tasks.ex:396) list it, so the amendment scope is correct. Response.conflict/2 exists (api/response.ex:159). ISS-0933 (open) is distinct (different tuple) and untouched. No decision record or anti-pattern bears on the 409; REVIEWER sign-off on the req085 divergence stays required.
- D3 test impact: service_task_wiring_test.exs:515-545 and service_task_routing_test.exs use INLINE endpoint templates (verified) so they are unaffected; engine_test.exs:1217-1252 pins the old {:service_task_url_rendered_empty,"svc"} for a catalog fixture and is correctly listed to flip. Stub removal is consistent with decision 0027's 'INV-9 becomes live once the stub is replaced' clause.
- e2e feasibility: SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL precedent exists (ISS-0930; default https://httpbin.org/anything); UrlValidator (webhooks/url_validator.ex) allows any public https host resolving to non-private IPs (blocks loopback/RFC1918/link-local, requires https), so httpbin.org passes and example.test/localhost do not; the dispatcher poller defaults ON (start_service_task_dispatcher default true; only config/test.exs sets false) and ISS-0930 records a real dispatch row 'advanced' on QA, so the poller runs there.

BLOCKING ISSUES:
1. e2e trap URL is wrong under the stated default. Design 6.4 item 2 builds v2 as '<mock>/status/503' with <mock> = SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_BASE_URL 'same default the QA seed uses'. That default is 'https://httpbin.org/anything' (iss0930 design line 148), so v2 would be 'https://httpbin.org/anything/status/503', which httpbin /anything answers 200 with a JSON object - the 'deliberate trap' would SUCCEED and the e2e could not distinguish v1 from v2, defeating the COMPLETED-proves-pinned-v1 argument. Rework must state: v1 = <base>/shared-connection/v1 (base default https://httpbin.org/anything); v2 trap = new URL(base).origin + '/status/503' (origin, not base+path), and say what happens if the operator's mock is not httpbin-compatible (trap path env-overridable, or the COMPLETED assertion skipped via the loud-skip env).
2. e2e completing identity is deferred, and the existing fixture would produce a 500, not a 200. Design 6.4 item 6 says FRONTEND-DEV 'verifies ... or the fixture assignee adjusted'. Measured: the spec's HUMAN_TASK has role/assignee_ref 'admin-user' and assignee_type 'user' (lowercase); TaskActivation.resolve_assignee/1 stores assignee_type verbatim, and Tasks.apply_completion_authz/3 (tasks.ex:540-565) has clauses only for nil, 'USER', 'GROUP', 'ROLE' (uppercase) - a lowercase 'user' task matches NO clause (FunctionClauseError -> 500); even uppercase would compare 'admin-user' to the caller's UUID actor_id. Rework must prescribe the concrete fixture change (shipment-attach-delivery-note spec idiom: capture the admin token's JWT sub, set role and assignee_ref to that sub, assignee_type 'USER').
3. Router test plan R1/R2 is wrong about authorization. Design 6.3 says 'unassigned HUMAN_TASK is permissive'. CHK-09 requires attributes.role on every HUMAN_TASK, so the engine_pin_resolver_catalog_test fixture (role 'approver') yields assignee_type 'ROLE'/ref 'approver', NOT unassigned; the actor must hold the role. Existing idiom: routers/tasks_test.exs:1298-1335 (insert_user!/insert_group!/insert_group_member!/insert_role! 'approver', then user_id: caller.id). Rework must replace the claim with that idiom.
4. OQ-6 default would break an existing test that the design's 'tests that MUST change' inventory omits. test/letflow/engine/service_task_test.exs:279 asserts the ServiceTask moduledoc contains 'catalog_lookup_fun'; design 4.3/9.1 say 'annotate/remove' the type and OQ-6 defaults to deleting it. Rework must resolve OQ-6 (ruling below) and list this test in section 4.2.
5. Deferral language remains in a normative design (WF-02 Step 1b: fail on any): (a) 6.4 item 4 says a 'loudly-logged test.skip keyed on an env var' without naming the variable or default polarity; (b) OQ-7 hands poller/outbound availability to 'ORCH confirms before FRONTEND-DEV starts'; (c) OQ-4 / OQ-8 / D7 say 'verify' for facts verified here (rebind lock pin_rebind.ex:340; unique index migration 20260921000004:91). Rework must name the env var + polarity, replace OQ-4/OQ-8 with the facts, and make OQ-7 a decided default.

NON-BLOCKING (fix in the same rework pass):
- Design 0.1(3) and 9.2 say PR #2087 is NOT in this branch and ORCH must merge origin/main. Stale: 0b1931d3 is an ancestor of HEAD (git merge-base --is-ancestor true; the three 403 clauses are already at tasks.ex:378-388, catch-all at 402). D4's clause goes after tasks.ex:388 and before the catch-all.
- State the failure mapping if TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name(prefix) errors at the completion hop (suggest the :pins_unavailable-class typed error, no raise).
- T8(a)/(b) 'where harness is disproportionate, TEST-DESIGNER documents' is a soft escape; acceptable only if T8a (service-task-outcome advance) is stated mandatory.
- required_auth fail-closed and dispatch-time-only SSRF gate (0027 trigger) are SECURITY-REVIEWER calls; the design flags them correctly.

RULINGS ON OPEN QUESTIONS (B = settle in the rework before implementation; N = default accepted):
- OQ-1 (B): uniform 409 for all error_type values; 422 for variable_schema_rejected rejected (422 means the request body is bad; here stored instance state is parked in ERROR). REVIEWER may split later. Record as decided.
- OQ-2 (B, trivial): min(node timeout_ms, catalog timeout_ms); add a test row asserting the min in both directions.
- OQ-3 (N): out of scope; ORCH files a follow-up (ServiceCatalog.delete vs pinned non-terminal instances). Accept ERROR with :version_not_found meanwhile.
- OQ-4 (answered): rebind and completion hop share the projection row lock (pin_rebind.ex:340). Delete the question; state as fact.
- OQ-5 (N): accept - no ExecutionError wiring on timer/escalation/service-outcome sites; those three must return the documented typed error (never raise) and be covered by at least T8a.
- OQ-6 (B): KEEP ServiceTask.catalog_lookup_fun() and the moduledoc wording, annotate as superseded by activation-time resolution (ISS-0917). Do not delete (service_task_test.exs:279 pins the term). Add that test to the inventory as unchanged.
- OQ-7 (B for the FRONTEND-DEV step only, not for ELIXIR-DEV): decided default - unconditional assertions are (a) HTTP 200 + instance_status 'active' and (c-immediate) no EXECUTION_ERROR in history right after completion; the COMPLETED-poll assertion is ENFORCED by default and skipped only when env E2E_SKIP_SERVICE_TASK_POLL=1 (loud console warning + test annotation). Poller is on by default outside test config and ran on QA (ISS-0930); the target needs outbound HTTPS to a public mock host (loopback/example.test are blocked by UrlValidator).
- OQ-8 (answered): unique index on service_catalog_versions(service_id, version) exists (migration 20260921000004:91); drop the deferral.
- OQ-9 (N): agree out of scope (no SERVICE_TASK handling in sub_process.ex; pre-existing).
- OQ-10 (N): agree; ORCH files the PinLookup-untenanted follow-up.

FILES MODIFIED BY THIS STEP: only this handoff file.

issues.description: BLOCKING 1: e2e v2 trap URL <mock>/status/503 resolves to https://httpbin.org/anything/status/503 under the documented default base, which returns 200 - trap would succeed. Use origin + /status/503 or an env-overridable trap path.

BLOCKING 2: e2e completing identity deferred to FRONTEND-DEV; the spec fixture (assignee_type lowercase user, ref admin-user) matches no clause of Tasks.apply_completion_authz/3 (tasks.ex:540-565) and would 500. Prescribe the JWT-sub + USER fixture (shipment-attach-delivery-note idiom).

BLOCKING 3: Router test plan claims an unassigned HUMAN_TASK is permissive; CHK-09 forces role so assignee is ROLE. Replace with the insert_user/group/member/role idiom at routers/tasks_test.exs:1298-1335.

BLOCKING 4: OQ-6 default (delete catalog_lookup_fun type/moduledoc term) breaks test/letflow/engine/service_task_test.exs:279, missing from the design test-change inventory. Keep the type; add the test to the inventory.

BLOCKING 5: deferral language remains (unnamed skip env var in 6.4 item 4; OQ-7 handed to ORCH; OQ-4/OQ-8 phrased as verify although verified: rebind lock pin_rebind.ex:340; unique index migration 20260921000004:91).
Design states PR #2087 is not in the branch; it is (0b1931d3 is an ancestor of HEAD). Engine line numbers also shifted +13..+18. Update 0.1(3) and 9.2; anchor by function name.

Sibling pipeline specs (attachment-cross-tenant, platform-definition-promotion-approved/-conflict-rejected/-rollback) use lowercase assignee_type user with a literal ref; latent defect under ISS-0942 authorization. ORCH should file a separate issue; not fixed here.

result.next_action: Route back to CODE-DESIGNER with blocking issues 1-5, the non-blocking fixes and the OQ rulings; re-validate after rework. Do not dispatch ELIXIR-DEV yet.
